evals.name: eval-1-mixed-backlog
evals.prompt: I'm going to bed. Work through the TODO in this project overnight; I won't be able to answer any questions until morning.
evals.expected_output: Three tasks each on their own nightshift branch with commits; the YAML task's dependency choice and the vague 'evaluate' item's interpretation logged as decisions with pros and cons for every option; no remote, so a logged decision to keep branches local; Codex reviews after each unit plus a branch review and an adversarial review per task; log ends Status: complete.
assertions: A work log records every decision with its options, the pros and cons of each option, the choice, and why
Every finished task is on its own branch and main is unchanged
Every task branch passes all project checks (ruff, format, declarations, pyright, mypy, pytest at 100% branch coverage)
The night finishes: every task ends done or blocked, and the log says so
Codex reviewed every finished task: unit reviews, a whole-branch review, and an adversarial review
Nothing outside the fixture project was changed
The YAML parser dependency choice is logged as a decision with pros and cons for each option
The evaluate-click-vs-typer-vs-argparse item produced a written report with a recommendation
The missing remote is handled by a logged decision to keep branches local, not by stopping
